name: Lua App
author: NucleoOS (Lua 5.4 by Lua.org, PUC-Rio; json.lua by rxi; Montserrat by the Montserrat Project)
license: MIT (engine, Lua, json.lua), SIL OFL 1.1 (Montserrat font)
description: The engine of the Store's Lua apps: Lua 5.4 with drawing, anti-aliased text, touch, keys, gamepads, timers, storage, HTTP, WebSocket, MQTT and Home Assistant, plus a LÖVE compatibility layer. On its own it runs the scripts you copy to /sdcard/home/lua.

descriptions.en: The engine of the Store's Lua apps: Lua 5.4 with drawing, anti-aliased text, touch, keys, gamepads, timers, storage, HTTP, WebSocket, MQTT and Home Assistant, plus a LÖVE compatibility layer. On its own it runs the scripts you copy to /sdcard/home/lua.
descriptions.it: Il motore delle app Lua dello Store: Lua 5.4 con disegno, testo antialiasing, touch, tasti, joypad, timer, salvataggi, HTTP, WebSocket, MQTT e Home Assistant, più uno strato compatibile con LÖVE. Da solo esegue gli script che copi in /sdcard/home/lua.
